mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 60 degrees with clear skies observed near Verona City Hall under the light of a New Moon.
In city news, residents can now apply for the Verona Police Department Citizen Academy which starts September 23, while various election notices for the November general election have been posted.

There is plenty to do with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow, and the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival this Saturday.
The police department reported that on Friday, September 4, 2026, officers arrested a 34-year-old Madison woman for sexual assault of a child by a school staff member.
Today's flavor is Raspberry Cheesecake and you can head over to enjoy it when the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
